programme.desc: 'S54/E5 - Casino Royale XL: Battle Four'. With a spot in the tournament's finale at stake, four chefs take on ingredients like the mysterious 'goat water' and a squirmy sea creature.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S60/E10 - Night Market Madness'. The night belongs to foodies as four chefs celebrate international night markets and the culinary creativity they inspire.

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Beach Day'. Jesse Palmers tasks the bakers to capture the coastal vibe using beach drink trifles! Then, they must create refreshing summer cream pies to avoid a scorching elimination.

programme.title: Holiday Wars
programme.desc: 'S4/E4 - Reindeer's New Hobby'. The six remaining teams face off for the first time as they must envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S35/E2 - Retro Thanksgiving'. The team goes back in time to give Turkey Day staples a tasty update. Dishes include classic Thanksgiving turkey and vintage cranberry sauce mould.

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S7/E7 - Out Of This World'. Valerie Bertinelli and Duff Goldman challenge the remaining three bakers to make cakes that look like a spaceship, an alien or planet. Who will be crowned winner?

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S9/E17 - Glasgow'. Andrew Zimmern explores the diverse culinary scene of Glasgow, Scotland. He tastes iconic dishes including macaroni pies, chicken tikka masala and venison haggis.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S9/E18 - Cork'. Andrew visits the city of Cork, Ireland, where fertile land and an expansive coastline make it a food lovers' haven. He tastes Irish stew, drisheen and smoked salmon.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S9/E19 - Calabria'. Andrew Zimmern explores the cuisine of Calabria, a relatively unknown side of Italy that outsiders rarely see. He tastes fileja noodles and anchovy stroncatura.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S9/E20 - Puglia'. Andrew Zimmern visits Puglia, a coastal region in Italy that is known for its centuries-old farmlands. He finds grilled octopus and stuffed pasticiotti pastries.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S9/E21 - Zagreb'. Andrew Zimmern dives into a meat-centric selection of foods in Zagreb, Croatia. He tastes pork kotlovina, tender veal cheeks and savoury stuffed peppers.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S9/E22 - Krakow'. Andrew Zimmern explores the delicious food scene in Krakow, Poland. He finds pierogis, hearty stuffed cabbage rolls and whole-roasted pork knuckle.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern
programme.desc: 'S6/E5 - Dubai Carp Camel And Cocoons'. Andrew Zimmern travels to Dubai in the United Arab Emirates. He learns the secret to milking camels, fermenting fish in the desert sun and making musical organ meat mush.

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S3/E12 - Playing With Fire In New England'. Roger Mooking meets two people in New England who love to play with fire. Paula Marcoux's garden is filled with cooking contraptions. While, David Adamson rents out do-it-yourself roast kits.

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S3/E13 - Spring Celebration In Kentucky'. Richard McCallister of Marksbury Farm Market, invites Roger Mooking to his annual Spring celebration in Lancaster, Kentucky.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S35/E12 - Surf And Savoury'. Guy Fieri grabs a little surf, turf and flavours from the earth. In Puerto Rico, a local gem is serving off-the-hook pork trifongo and shrimp empanadas.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S3/E5 - Manila'. From popular street snacks to classic homemade stews, Andrew reveals Manila's iconic foods. Whole roasted pork and crispy batter-fried quail eggs are on the menu.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations

programme.desc: 'S1/E93'. Could Mbali and Lindelani manage to keep their wedding a secret while they deal with their complicated pasts?

programme.title: Rhythm City
programme.desc: 'S1/E132'. The battle between the real power brokers of the music industry: the record companies, promoters, producers, DJs and the stars - but also the wannabe stars, the has-beens, families and lovers.

programme.title: Naagin
programme.desc: 'S7/E10 - Naagin's Revenge Claims Swarna'. Purvi and Vikram's engagement ceremony begins as they exchange rings. Later, Purvi transforms into the Naagin, stabs and kills Swarna, framing Samir for the crime.

programme.title: India: A Love Story
programme.desc: 'S1/E157'. Showing the great differences between the cultures of India and Brazil, the story focuses on the forbidden passion between two very different Indians of origin.

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm
programme.desc: 'S2/E25'. Efsun's private detective Edip interrogates everyone. Bahar goes shopping for her date, and Evren warns Cem to stay away from Umay.

programme.title: Bloedspoor
programme.desc: 'S3/E4'. The past juxtaposes the present as Ilgaz and Ceylin clash over the case. Not everything is as it seems and we realize just how much has changed in the past few years.

programme.title: Bittersoet
programme.desc: 'S2/E37'. A discovery in Asu's room makes Kemal suspicious about her relationship with Tufan. Another discovery leads Kemal to question the truth about Asu's childhood.

programme.title: Sout van die Aarde
programme.desc: 'S2/E47'. Muammer and Dondu throw a welcome party for Kenan, but Wessel thinks it is for his daughter, which leads to an argument. Ramazan and Asuman make up.

programme.title: Entertainment Set
programme.desc: Entertainment highlights, news and reviews.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S2/E126'. Ziya learns Yaman's disease and has a crisis. Yaman calms him down. Canan makes a new plan to give her liver to Yaman. Semra leaves also Ayten's house and gets lost. Duygu starts to look for her mother once again.

programme.title: 'n Ma se Hart
programme.desc: 'S1/E46 - 1/46'. Hulya seeks temporary refuge from Melike. Duru spirals after her father's death. Yusuf delivers a chilling warning that leaves Berrin rattled.

programme.title: Op 'n Afgrond
programme.desc: 'S1/E45'. Sumru opens up about the abuse she suffered from Halil, while Tahsin urges her to focus on the present as they prepare for Melek's release.

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm
programme.desc: 'S2/E26'. Edip reveals the guilty party, throwing everything into chaos and forcing Uras and Selen to reconsider the wedding.

programme.title: Bloedspoor
programme.desc: 'S3/E5'. Ilgaz and Ceylin butt heads over the case they now have to share. Merdan willingly checks into a retirement home, but Tugce smells a rat.

programme.title: Die Put
